Title: 502320-2026: Italy – Integrated engineering services – Open procedure S006_2026_PONTE VALNONTEY
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Refurbishment of a bridge structure (Ponte Valnontey) in Italy – bridge projects are generally relevant for sbp; as this appears to be a small local structure in Italy without information on span length and not located in DACH/Africa, it has only medium priority.
titel: Open procedure S006_2026_PONTE VALNONTEY – Engineering services for the new construction of the Valnontey bridge
kurzbeschreibung: Engineering services for the replacement construction of the bridge in the Valnontey district in Cogne.
umfang: Engineering services for the renewal or replacement construction of the bridge in the Valnontey district in the municipality of Cogne. The notice does not state technical key data such as span, bridge length, width, structural type or construction method.
leistungen: Engineering services in connection with the construction works for the renewal of the Valnontey bridge; the notice does not further break down the exact scopes of services and service phases.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Bridge project with a direct link to engineering services and therefore fundamentally a very good fit with the sbp profile.
• It concerns a new or replacement bridge, which is strategically more interesting than purely consulting or framework contracts.
• The contract is awarded to the most economically advantageous tender based on the best price-performance ratio and not solely on price.
• The exact structural complexity remains unclear, as no spans, structural type or special technical requirements are stated.
• The location in Italy is generally relevant for sbp, but without any particular geographical priority bonus.
• The contract value for design services is solid and indicates a medium-sized bridge project.
baukosten_erklaerung: The notice does not state any construction costs. Only an estimated contract value for the engineering services of 455640.34 EUR net is given. For a reliable derivation of cost groups 300+400, information on structure size, structural type, service phases and fee basis is missing. Depending on the scope of services and the Italian fee system, a rough construction cost range could be in the low single-digit to mid double-digit million range, but this is not reliable enough for a numerical indication here.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Registration in a relevant professional register; registration in the commercial register; professional indemnity insurance; relevant academic and professional qualifications; certificates from independent bodies for environmental management systems or standards.
zuschlagskriterien: Most economically advantageous tender based on the best price-performance ratio; quality is explicitly mentioned, but the notice does not state a weighting.
auftraggeber: Regione Autonoma Valle dAosta, 11100 Aosta, Italy, contact: Ester Ronzani, e-mail: segretario_generale@pec.regione.vda.it, phone: 0165273111, website: www.regione.vda.it
notes: Estimated contract value net: 455640.34 EUR. Duration: 570 days. Language of tenders: Italian. Electronic submission via https://place-vda.aflink.it/ required. Deadline for questions: 27.08.2026, 12:00 Uhr. The notice does not state any technical bridge data and no detailed breakdown of service phases.
